package.name: diff_ik_core
package.description: Pure C++ differential inverse kinematics (Eigen only, no ROS): Jacobian quality measures (sigma_min, condition number, manipulability, velocity-ellipsoid gain along a direction, joint limit margin), a damped-least-squares velocity step with singular-value-adaptive damping, weighted null-space costs (joint centering, limit avoidance, lift bias), uniform task scaling at the velocity limits with hard position-limit zones, a pose-error helper with a feedback law, and an acceleration-limited integration step. Builds and tests with ROS not sourced. Simulation-only math: no controller plugin yet, not run on hardware.
